verdict.rationale: Convex is a reactive backend database and functions platform, not an agent or AI client that consumes tools, so acting as an MCP client is the wrong axis for this kind of product. The evidence shows only that Convex ships its own MCP server for external agents to use (convex-docs-10, convex-probe-4). That is the server role, belongs to a different story, and cannot be credited here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
